title: Virtual Compute: invoice maturity period
content:
## Meaning — invoice maturity period

Virtual Compute invoice maturity period: Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer.

## Tier values — invoice maturity period

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — invoice maturity period: 30.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for invoice maturity period?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has invoice maturity period of 30.

## Meaning — minimum invoice amount

Virtual Compute minimum invoice amount: Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

## Tier values — minimum invoice amount

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — minimum invoice amount: 0.5.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for invoice maturity period?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has minimum invoice amount of 0.5.
